_comment: Bashan OS light variant. Same token names as palette.json, so every generator reads either file without a special case. Roles are preserved, not colours: bg_deep is the text-entry surface in both files (near-black in dark, white here), bg_void is the strongest-contrast surface, and so on. The accent is NOT the dark-mode #22d3ee: that cyan measures 1.7:1 on white and is unreadable as text, so the light accent is the same hue darkened to #0e7490 (4.9:1 on bg_base). The glow colour of the logo is kept for decoration only, never for text.
